parts.role: Bulk on +40V at the terminal. POLARITY SETTLED 2026-08-08 (P4 review E2), and this is the finding the empty datasheet field caused: the reviewer could not adjudicate pin 1 because the EasyEDA symbol puts '+' at pin 1 while the footprint's only asymmetric silk feature - two chamfered corners - sits on the PAD-1 side, and a chamfered base corner conventionally marks the CATHODE on V-chip electrolytics. The manufacturer document is now fetched, committed at parts/C51953411.pdf (JIERR, 'RVT series', 6 pp; page 6 lists this exact PN 100uF/10X10.5/200mA/tan-d 0.14) and the datasheet field above is filled. Page 2's dimension drawing labels the two terminals 'Positive' and 'Negative' explicitly, and the 'Positive' leader lands on the CHAMFERED end; the D=10.0 row (A=10.3, B=10.3, C=11.1, P=4.5) matches the pulled footprint name BD10.0-L10.3-W10.3-LS11.0 exactly. Cross-checked against the Lumimax SMDGP/RVT-series drawing, whose top-view marking figure puts the black negative stripe on the SQUARE-cornered side - same conclusion from the opposite face. SO: chamfer = ANODE on this family, the footprint's chamfers are on the pad-1 side, pad 1 = anode, and the schematic's pin-1-to-+40V wiring is CORRECT. No part swap needed. P6 OBLIGATION UNCHANGED AND NOW BETTER SPECIFIED: the footprint carries no polarity mark on F.SilkS or F.Fab, and the silk body square (+/-5.23 mm) is entirely hidden by the 10.3 mm plastic base once assembled, so the chamfer cue is invisible for inspection - P6 must add a silk '+' OUTSIDE the body square near pad 1 (free space at about x=-6.0, |y|=2.5-5.0, inside the courtyard and clear of the pads) plus an F.Fab body outline with a polarity marker. Everything below is the P3 sourcing record and is unchanged. RE-SOURCED 2026-08-07: the previous entry C54321630 / MA63V100M10X10 has NO EasyEDA CAD data (3 pull attempts failed), so it could never reach a footprint. Swapped to the documented alternate, which pulls cleanly and is deeply stocked - 23372 vs the 5x10=50 required. 63V rating still satisfies the P1 finding that LC inrush overshoots to ~51V (transient 81% of rating; steady-state 40V = 63%). DIELECTRIC SUBSTITUTED POLYMER -> ALUMINIUM ELECTROLYTIC: much higher ESR (order 0.4-1 ohm vs order 20 mohm) and a modest 200mA@120Hz ripple rating, judged acceptable because this cap is DC-bus hold-up only - at 20 MHz it is far past self-resonance, the switching and RF ripple are carried by C103/C104 and the C207-C212 HF bank, and the ESR actively DAMPS the turn-on ring. parts.role: ONE PART, THREE ROLES, per architecture's explicit BOM commonality note: the C_shunt trim sites (C203-C206, 4 sites, C205/C206 DNP - populate to raise C_shunt, empty the bank for a max-Coss FET pair), the C_s tank bank (C301-C309, 9x, 504 pF) and the C_m match bank (C310-C318, 9x). CHANGED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW W1: C_m used to be 10 x 56 pF = 560 pF from this part alone, which is +5.7% on the 530.4 pF ideal L-match and presented 3.74 + j0.68 ohm to the tank (VSWR 1.22, series X/R 1.47 against the Class E optimum 1.1525, ~221 W not 200 W at a 40 V bus). One of those ten sites (C319) is now a 27 pF part of the same family, giving 531 pF, 4.12 + j0.07 ohm, VSWR 1.02, X/R 1.19 and ~200 W. So this line drops from 21 to 22 SITES but from 10 to 9 in the C_m bank. Current sharing follows capacitance, so each 56 pF part in C_m now carries 56/531 x 6.66 = 0.70 A rms (was 0.67 A); C_s parts carry 0.77 A rms and ~105 mW each. 22 sites x 5 boards = 110 pieces at full population; re-verified stock 8106 clears 5x110=550. 1kV C0G confirmed - no X7R anywhere in the tank, per the architecture rule, and 1 kV is >=6.6x the 151 V pk across the C_s bank. P8 FIX PASS 2026-08-08 (board review, owner ruling H4): TWO POPULATE CHANGES, both because the POURS are part of the capacitance and were never folded in. (a) REVIEW E2 - C318 IS NOW DNP. The /tank/RFOUT F.Cu pour is 371.5 mm2, 84.5% of it over In1 GND at 0.2444 mm, and adds a measured 46.1 pF to GND right at the C_m node. 9 x 56 + 27 = 531 pF therefore SHIPPED as 577 pF - past the 560 pF bank P4 review W1 explicitly rejected (3.53 + j1.01 ohm, series X/R 1.65 against the Class E optimum 1.1525, ~233 W). 8 x 56 + 27 = 475 pF populated + 46.1 = 521 pF, -1.8% on the 530.4 pF ideal, presenting 4.26 - j0.15 ohm and X/R 1.10. C318 is the far end of the column, so depopulating it costs least in current sharing. (b) REVIEW W2 - C204 MOVES TO THE 27 pF LINE (C541492). The /SW pour adds 27.4 pF, so 2 x 56 = 112 pF external shipped 316 + 112 + 27.4 = 455.4 pF against a 403-449 pF requirement - over the top. 56 + 27 = 83 pF gives 316 + 83 + 27.4 = 426.4 pF, the middle of the band. C205/C206 stay DNP headroom: the bank EMPTIES for a max-Coss pair, which is why it exists. P8 FIX a3 2026-08-08 (the SPICE benches in kicad/sims/ - the FIRST time this board's declared simulations were executed; reports/sim-notes.md). THE ZVS POPULATE FIX, three sites, no new part and no new land: C308 and C309 go DNP, the C320 trim site is POPULATED, and C203 goes DNP. C_s 504 -> 419 pF and the C_shunt bank 83 -> 27 pF. WHY C_s FALLS, because it is counter-intuitive and someone will 'fix' it back: zone B carries no plane on any layer (D4 - a plane under a PCB air-core spiral is a shorted turn), so the TANK_A -> C_s bank -> TANK_B run has NO RETURN IMAGE and its partial self-inductance is free-space-like, ~30 nH (25-35 nH band) rather than the ~4 nH a microstrip model gives. At 20 MHz that is j3.77 ohm = 0.91 R dropped into a network whose entire design reactance is 1.283 R. EXTRA SERIES L IS CANCELLED BY LESS SERIES C: X_net = w(L_s+L_bridge) - 1/(wC_s) + X_match, and 1/(wC_s) grows as C_s shrinks. Measured on the same deck, same 30 V bench: X_net/R 2.00 -> 1.285 (design target 1.283), Vds at turn-on 15.60 -> 1.41 V, dVds/dt -5.89 -> -1.21 V/ns, P_out 53.4 -> 113.8 W, Vds,pk 122.2 V on a 200 V part. The fix holds across the whole 25-35 nH stray band (X/R 1.144 at 25 nH, 1.426 at 35 nH). The C_shunt half is NOT a separate finding: the ZVS-optimal shunt depends on the tank, so when C_s falls the optimum bank falls with it (bank 83 pF -> 15.6 V, 27 pF -> 1.41 V, 56 pF -> 3.94 V, i.e. not a knife edge). EFFECT ON THIS LINE: three more sites go DNP (C203 from the C_shunt bank, C308/C309 from the C_s bank), so populated qty falls 18 -> 15 of 21 sites. 21 sites x 5 boards = 105 pieces at FULL population (75 at the shipped populate); stock re-verified live 2026-08-08 at 8086, which clears 5 x 105 = 525 by 15x. PER-PART DUTY ROSE: current divides in proportion to capacitance, so each populated 56 pF C_s part now carries 56/419 x 6.96 = 0.93 A rms (was 56/504 x 6.96 = 0.77 A over nine parts, +21 %) and ~150 mW instead of ~105 mW. Inside a 1 kV C0G 1206's capability, but the C_s bank's temperature rise is a BRING-UP MEASUREMENT, not an assumption.

This is the architecture's own PRE-AUTHORISED escape (blocks.md B6, '2 x 0.47 uH in series'), not an improvisation: no single LCSC part combines L>=0.82uH + SRF>=80MHz + DCR<=25mohm + Isat>=12A - every catalog power/shielded/molded family either omits SRF entirely or, where SRF IS published (Sagami/FH 'RF' 0603 chip inductors), tops out at 300 mA against the ~6-9 A this choke carries. Series pair: combined L=0.94uH (14% over floor), combined DCR=8.2mohm (67% under the 25mohm budget), each leg Isat 20A. SRF NOT DATASHEET-PUBLISHED for either candidate and STILL NOT CLOSED - the P4 review lists it under 'what could not be verified' and it is worth closing before fab, because a choke resonating near 20 MHz stops being a choke; the architecture's own research already requires an empirical SRF sweep at bring-up (dummy load + RF detector) regardless of any datasheet claim. 10nF 100V X7R 0603, FIVE sites now: C207-C210 (bus HF decoupling bank, 4x of the 4x10nF+2x1nF pair) AND C107, the LM5017 BOOTSTRAP cap. THE C107 ASSIGNMENT IS P4 REVIEW E4, AND IT IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THAT FINDING: parts.json used to map C107 to C519422, a 2.2 nF 25 V part carrying the role text 'PLACEHOLDER VALUE - P4 confirms against LM5017's internal HS driver bootstrap spec'. P4 confirmed it in the SCHEMATIC (10 nF per datasheet s8.2.1.2.6, 'A good value for CBST = 0.01 uF') and never wrote back here - and because bom_cpl builds the BOM from parts.json, the assembled boards would have shipped a bootstrap cap 4.5x under spec with no gate catching it, since the ref DID have an LCSC number, just the wrong one. C519422 is deleted. 100 V against a 13 V BST-to-SW absolute maximum is 7.7x. DIELECTRIC SUBSTITUTED C0G->X7R for the C207-C210 role: architecture (blocks.md B6) specifies '100V C0G' and live search found genuine 100V/10nF C0G stock is effectively zero across every package; legitimate here because these caps sit on the +40V bus feed to L201, NOT in the resonant tank, and the brief itself states 'X7R is fine on the DC bus but NEVER in the tank'. Stock re-verified live 2026-08-08 against the new 5x25=125 need.

1nF 100V C0G 0603, THREE sites: C211/C212 terminate the bus HF bank's self-resonance, and C110 is Cr, the Type 3 ripple-injection ramp integrator on `hk` (P4 added that network; this line was never updated for it - review E5). Genuine C0G at the correct value/voltage/package, no substitution. Cr's tolerance matters more than a bypass cap's: it sets the injected ramp amplitude and therefore, through the COT valley-regulation mechanism, the DC level of the +5 V rail - the E3 divider solve carries Cr's +/-5% explicitly. Stock re-verified live 2026-08-08.

alternates.note: Yageo, same 30.9k 0402 1%, stock 9204, $0.0038 - use if the Uniroyal line runs down. Any 1% 30.9k 0402 works; the tolerance is the load-bearing spec, not the brand.

parts.role: FB divider TOP leg (RFB2). ADDED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW E3, replacing C25553 / 0402WGJ0303TCE - a 30.0k part whose 'J' code is +/-5%, while R102/R103/R104 were all 'F' = 1%. The top leg is the dominant term, so the 5% part alone dragged the rail's low corner to 4.586 V, under the LMG1020's 4.75 V minimum VDD, and broke the IN+ absolute maximum (VDD+0.3 = 4.886 V) against the mandated unipolar 0/+5 V drive - the drive would forward-bias the input clamp on every cycle. The fix is BOTH 1% AND a re-centred ratio: 30.9k/10.0k gives N = 4.090, and the rail clears 4.75-5.40 V under both readings of where a COT part with Type 3 ripple injection actually regulates (envelope 4.835-5.381 V; IN+ margin +135 mV; EPC2019 VGS margin 0.62 V; LM5017 FB OVP 1.62 V vs a 1.34 V worst-case FB peak). The full two-model derivation, including why the reviewer's suggested 31.6k is NOT taken, is in kicad/gen/hk.py's docstring. 5 pieces needed, 5x25 rule cleared 195x. Stock verified live 2026-08-08.

R103 = COT RON (Fsw-setting) resistor, RON pin to VIN, fSW = VOUT/(K.RON) = 562 kHz. R104 = Rr, the Type 3 ripple-injection resistor, BUCK_SW to RINJ. ADDED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW W2, replacing C25741 / 0402WGF1003TCE at the same 100k value. THE LIMIT IS WORKING VOLTAGE, NOT POWER (16 mW): a thick-film 0402 is rated 50 V maximum working voltage, and R103 sits from the RON pin - held near ground by the on-timer - to +40V, so the whole bus stands across it continuously. 40 V is 80% of an 0402's limit with nothing left for the ~51 V LC turn-on overshoot P1 predicted on this bus, which exceeds it outright. R104 MOVED TOO, which the review did not require but which is the same defect one step quieter: Rr spans BUCK_SW to RINJ, so it stands off VIN-VOUT = 35 V normally and ~46 V on that same ring - 92% of an 0402's rating. The 0805 part is rated 150 V: 3.8x on the 40 V steady state, 2.9x on the ring. Moving both onto one part also DELETES a BOM line (the 100k 0402 disappears entirely). JLC Basic part, 6.0M in stock against a 5x10=50 need.

alternates.note: Samwha, same 2.2uF 50V X7R 0805 10%, stock 17780, $0.062 - 2.2x cheaper and still clears 5x5=25 by 711x. Kept as the alternate rather than the primary only because the Yageo line is the one already used elsewhere on this BOM.

parts.role: LM5017 VCC decoupler (C106). ADDED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW W3, replacing the 1uF 16V 0603 (C106248) this ref used to carry. THE DEFECT IS DC-BIAS DERATING, NOT THE NOMINAL VALUE: the datasheet wants 1.0 uF of REAL capacitance on VCC, and VCC is an internal linear regulator output at 7.6 V typ (up to 8.55 V over temperature). A 16 V 0603 X7R at 48-53% of its rated bias loses 35-50% of its value and lands at 0.5-0.65 uF - half the requirement - and that same cap sources the internal-diode recharge of the bootstrap cap every cycle, so the shortfall compounds C107. At 8.55 V the 50 V part sits at 17% of rating, where an 0805 X7R loses roughly 15-25%: >= 1.65 uF effective. Startup is unaffected - VCC's ~26 mA internal current limit charges 2.2 uF to 7.6 V in ~0.6 ms - and the datasheet sets no upper bound on CVCC.

alternates.note: 200 ohm 1206 1% 250mW, stock 336268, $0.007 - the FOUR-in-parallel alternative (4 x 200 = 50 ohm, 0.0625 W each = 39% of the 100 C derated rating). Equivalent margin in smaller bodies at twice the part count; take it if 2010 bodies are awkward at the connector.

parts.role: 50 ohm drive-input termination, R201||R202, AT THE CONNECTOR. ADDED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW E6, replacing C17408 / 0805W8F1000T5E at the same 100 ohm value. THE OLD SIZING WAS OFF BY EXACTLY 2x because it was computed for a bipolar +/-2.5 V waveform: the design MANDATES unipolar 0/+5 V (decisions.md D8), and a 0/+5 V square at the Class-E nominal 50% duty dissipates P = (5^2/50) x 0.5 = 0.250 W in the termination, i.e. 0.125 W per part - exactly 100% of an 0805's 1/8 W rating at 70 C and ~154% of its capability in the 100 C-class local environment blocks.md itself assumes. They would have drifted and then opened, leaving the SMA line unterminated and putting the reflected edge on an input whose absolute maximum E3 had already shown to be marginal. The 2010 part is 750 mW (485 mW derated to 100 C): 25.8% used, 3.9x margin. Package parasitics are irrelevant at 20 MHz - about 1.5 nH per 2010, 0.75 nH for the pair, j0.09 ohm against 50 ohm. DC-coupled per D8; no series cap. 10 pieces needed, 5x50 rule cleared 234x.

alternates.note: Yageo 4.7 ohm 1206 1% 250mW, stock 227952, $0.0346 - same power rating in a larger body, and the gate-loop budget (now ~1.70 nH) can afford it. Use if the KOA 0805 line runs down. Do NOT substitute an 0603: 100 mW is 65 mW once derated to a 90 C local board, against 0.100 W of actual dissipation at the max-Qg corner.

parts.role: GATE RESISTORS R203-R206 - one 0805 per leg per FET, ALL FOUR LEGS ON THIS ONE PART AGAIN. P8 FIX PASS 2026-08-08 (board review, owner ruling H4): the turn-OFF pair R205/R206 is reverted 6R8 (C5639707) -> 4R7. The 6R8 value was bought at P7 against a common-source-inductance term estimated 'of the order of volts'; the P8 board review MEASURED it. All four EPC2019 source escapes (0.49 / 0.55 / 0.55 / 1.47 nH) land on ONE F.Cu GND island, so the inductance common to the gate loop and the power loop is their PARALLEL combination, 0.157 nH - about 5x below P7's 0.768 nH single-escape figure. The injected term is therefore +0.38 V at 2.4 A/ns (+0.63 V at P7's 8 A/ns pair figure) plus 0.14-0.20 V of Miller, against VGSth_min 0.8 V - not a destruct path. At 4R7 the turn-off ring is -0.85 V against a -4 V floor (4.7x) and the first positive recovery is +0.14 V; the +6 V rail is set by the OUTH loop and peaks at ~5.005 V either way. What the revert buys is ~0.85 W across the pair at 40 V (~0.72 W at the derated 36 V bus) and about 4-6 C of Tj on the board whose thermal path is its hardest problem. BRING-UP OBLIGATION: measure VGS at the die during the turn-off edge - that mechanism is the one thing the second-order RLC model does not contain. TI'S >= 2 OHM MANDATE IS AT EACH OUTH/OUTL PIN, AND BOTH EPC2019 HANG OFF THE SAME PINS: with N devices on one pin each branch must be >= N x 2 ohm, so at N = 2 the floor is 4 ohm; 4.7 ohm gives 2.35 ohm per pin and 2.13 A of peak drive against 7 A source / 5 A sink. Q201 and Q202 branches are IDENTICAL by construction - same part, same reel, same 1% tolerance - which is what keeps static sharing and differential-mode damping symmetric, and having all four legs on ONE line restores that for the turn-off side too. PACKAGE IS 0805 BECAUSE OF DISSIPATION: Qg 1.8 nC typ / 2.5 nC max -> Qg.VDD.fSW = 0.18/0.25 W per FET, half per edge, of which the external resistor takes ~80% = 0.072 W typ / 0.100 W max per part; this 0805 is 250 mW (191 mW derated to a 90 C local board) = 52% used at the max-Qg corner. An 0603 (65 mW derated) would repeat the P4 E6 defect. GATE-LOOP CRITICAL-DAMPING BUDGET is 1.70 nH per FET (EPC WP008 Eq.1, L <= R^2.C_GS/4, R = 4.7+0.4+0.75 = 5.85 ohm, C_GS 199 pF); constraints.json still declares 0.48 nH deliberately. 20 pieces needed for a 5-board build; stock 14856 re-verified live 2026-08-08, 5x100 rule cleared 148x. P8 FIX a3 2026-08-08: THE 4R7 REVERT IS CONFIRMED BY SIMULATION, not just by the review's inductance re-measurement. kicad/sims/gate_symmetry.cir measures VGS AT THE DIE through the real gate loop with the 0.157 nH common-source inductance in place: 4R7 gives VGS max 5.04 V and VGS min -0.19 V against the EPC2019's +6 / -4 V abs max (21x margin on the negative rail), off-state VGS 0.12 V against a 0.8 V minimum threshold (6.5x), and 0.07 % peak-current sharing between the mirrored dice. The 6R8 variant was run in the same deck and buys 0.063 V of undershoot margin for ~4 C of Tj. 4R7 IS CORRECT - DO NOT GO BACK. Stock and price re-verified LIVE 2026-08-08 at the P8 fix a3 close-out: 14856 pcs, $0.0099; 20 pieces needed for a 5-board build, so the 5x100 rule clears by 148x.

alternates.note: TDK, 100 ohm@100MHz, 20 mohm DCR, 4A, 0805, stock 222251, $0.027 - equivalent, marginally lower DCR. Do NOT substitute a 600-ohm-class bead: those run 220-300 mohm and would spend 22-30 mV of the ~85 mV rail margin E3 fought for.

parts.role: FB201 - series filter between the buck output (+5V) and the driver's VDD rail (+5V_DRV). ADDED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW W4, which is the finding parts/C34355.json layout_notes[7] had explicitly deferred to P4/P6 ('filtering on the +5V feed to LMG1020 is needed regardless of the exact RON/fSW chosen; not resolved by component selection alone'). P4 resolved the DECOUPLING (C201/C202/C213 at the driver, C108/C109 at the buck, all correct per their datasheets) but added no series element, leaving +5V one low-impedance node from L101 to U201.A1. The driver draws 2 x Qg x fSW = 72 mA typ / 100 mA max AT A 20 MHz REPETITION RATE; with nothing in series that current returns across the whole board to C108 - which sits on `hk` at the far end of zone A by design - instead of staying inside the driver's local 1.1 uF, i.e. a board-scale 20 MHz loop running past the FB trace TI's own layout guideline 3 says to keep clear of switching nodes. The bead turns C108 || FB201 || (C201+C202+C213) into a pi filter. CHOSEN FOR DCR, NOT PEAK IMPEDANCE: 30 mohm is a 3 mV drop at 100 mA, and E3's rail floor has only ~85 mV of margin to the LMG1020's 4.75 V minimum. Charge transfer per switching cycle is 2 x Qg = 5 nC max, which droops the local 1.1 uF by 4.5 mV - the bead does not starve the driver. NOT A PROTECTION PART (no TVS/fuse/NTC is added anywhere; owner-acknowledged at P0 Q11). Consequence for the netlist: +5V_DRV is a separate global rail with its own PWR_FLAG on `stage` and its own power[] entry in kicad/constraints.json.

parts.role: TANK FINE-TUNE AND BENCH-TRIM PART. ADDED 2026-08-08 BY P4 REVIEW W1. Same Yageo family, rating and package as the 56 pF part (C113875) - deliberately, so the tank keeps its one-footprint discipline. TWO JOBS. (1) C319 is POPULATED and completes C_m: 9 x 56 + 1 x 27 = 531 pF against the 530.4 pF ideal L-match, replacing a 10 x 56 = 560 pF bank that presented 3.74 + j0.68 ohm to the tank - VSWR 1.22, series X/R 1.47 against the Class E optimum 1.1525, and ~221 W rather than 200 W at a 40 V bus, which inflated I_dc, FET conduction loss and the 11.25 W / Tj 114 C two-FET thermal budget the whole paralleling decision rests on. As built now: 4.12 + j0.07 ohm, VSWR 1.02, X/R 1.19, ~200 W (20 MHz, L_s 164 nH, C_s 504 pF, L_m 110 nH into 50 ohm). C_s stays 9 x 56 = 504 pF - inside its 518 pF +/-5% window and within 1% of the 499 pF that would put X/R exactly on 1.1525, so it needs no third value. (2) C320-C323 are DNP BENCH-TRIM SITES, two per bank, which neither bank had: only C_shunt got DNP pads, so the tank could previously only be trimmed DOWN in 56 pF (11%) steps by depopulation. Now each bank trims both ways - +27/+54 pF by populating, -27 pF by depopulating C319, -56 pF per depopulated 56 pF site, and a fine C_s down-trim of 8 x 56 + 2 x 27 = 502 pF. That matters because L301/L302 are ETCHED SPIRALS whose realised inductance is the largest unknown in the tank (+/-10% is ordinary) and the capacitor banks are the only knob that answers it; SIM-4 still arbitrates C_s (OPEN-12). Current sharing follows capacitance: the 27 pF part in C_m carries 27/531 x 6.66 = 0.34 A rms. 5 sites x 5 boards = 25 pieces at full population; stock 7680 clears 5x25=125 by 61x. P8 FIX PASS 2026-08-08 (board review, owner ruling H4): GAINS C204 (review W2): the C_shunt bank goes 2 x 56 pF -> 56 + 27 pF because the /SW pour's measured 27.4 pF put the as-built shunt at 455.4 pF, above the 403-449 pF band. Same 1206 land, same 1 kV C0G family, so this is a value change on an existing site, not a new footprint. 30 pieces needed for a 5-board build (10 populated). P8 FIX a3 2026-08-08 (the SPICE benches in kicad/sims/ - the FIRST time this board's declared simulations were executed; reports/sim-notes.md). THE ZVS POPULATE FIX, three sites, no new part and no new land: C308 and C309 go DNP, the C320 trim site is POPULATED, and C203 goes DNP. C_s 504 -> 419 pF and the C_shunt bank 83 -> 27 pF. WHY C_s FALLS, because it is counter-intuitive and someone will 'fix' it back: zone B carries no plane on any layer (D4 - a plane under a PCB air-core spiral is a shorted turn), so the TANK_A -> C_s bank -> TANK_B run has NO RETURN IMAGE and its partial self-inductance is free-space-like, ~30 nH (25-35 nH band) rather than the ~4 nH a microstrip model gives. At 20 MHz that is j3.77 ohm = 0.91 R dropped into a network whose entire design reactance is 1.283 R. EXTRA SERIES L IS CANCELLED BY LESS SERIES C: X_net = w(L_s+L_bridge) - 1/(wC_s) + X_match, and 1/(wC_s) grows as C_s shrinks. Measured on the same deck, same 30 V bench: X_net/R 2.00 -> 1.285 (design target 1.283), Vds at turn-on 15.60 -> 1.41 V, dVds/dt -5.89 -> -1.21 V/ns, P_out 53.4 -> 113.8 W, Vds,pk 122.2 V on a 200 V part. The fix holds across the whole 25-35 nH stray band (X/R 1.144 at 25 nH, 1.426 at 35 nH). The C_shunt half is NOT a separate finding: the ZVS-optimal shunt depends on the tank, so when C_s falls the optimum bank falls with it (bank 83 pF -> 15.6 V, 27 pF -> 1.41 V, 56 pF -> 3.94 V, i.e. not a knife edge). EFFECT ON THIS LINE: C320 STOPS BEING A DNP TRIM SITE AND IS POPULATED - 419 pF is reachable exactly as 7 x 56 + 1 x 27, which is the whole reason a second value exists on this tank. Populated qty rises 2 -> 3 of 6 sites (C204, C319, C320); C321/C322/C323 stay DNP. C_s's remaining UP-trim is now C321 alone (+27 pF). 6 sites x 5 boards = 30 pieces at full population (15 at the shipped populate); stock re-verified live 2026-08-08 at 7680, which clears 5 x 30 = 150 by 51x. C320 carries 27/419 x 6.96 = 0.45 A rms.
